newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Aer Rianta joins bid for Australian airports.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Aer Rianta joins bid for Australian airports.

text.p: The Australian Airport Services consortium said Irish government-owned airports authority Aer Rianta is to join the consortium to explore opportunities in the Australian government's airport privatisation programme.
Australian Airport Services was formed by Australian transport group Brambles Industries Ltd and property and financial services group Lend Lease Corp Ltd.
The group said Aer Rianta would bring its experience as a airport owner and operator, as well as 'duty-free' operations.
Aer Rianta is the airport operator of Ireland's three main airports, Dublin, Cork and Shannon.

Australian Airport Services Emmet Hobbs said in a statement that the joint venture was interested in all airports in the first tranche and hoped to use the success in those ventures as a base for development of airport services outside of Australia.
Hobbs said Aer Rianta would have several senior staff join the bid team on a full time basis.
